tests_executed.welcome_email_register_smoke: POST /api/auth/register (new user, no SMTP) → 200 in <2s (non-blocking ✅). But NO 'welcome' kind row appears in /api/admin/emails/logs — see minor issue below.

minor.issue: Spec expected a 'welcome' kind email_logs row with status='failed' + error_class='MISSING_CONFIG' when SMTP is unconfigured, but server.py L320 short-circuits with `if not cfg_doc.get('smtp_host'): return` BEFORE calling send_email(), so no log entry is ever persisted. Registration itself is non-blocking and works (200). Recommend: drop the early-return and let send_email() handle MISSING_CONFIG classification so the welcome attempt is visible in the Email Delivery Log. Low priority — visibility gap only, not a functional break.
Pre-existing from iter_6/iter_7 — test_deep_audit::test_slip_today_legs_are_realistic asserts len(legs)>0 but today's slate is empty (Odds API stub). NOT a Phase 7 regression.

seed_admin behavior verified by direct experiment: an admin doc with an updated hashed password+pwv survives `supervisorctl restart backend` intact. CRITICAL prod-grade requirement met. ✅

email_service.py — error classification (MISSING_CONFIG / WRONG_PASSWORD / INVALID_APP_PASSWORD / SMTP_BLOCKED / TLS_ERROR / TIMEOUT / HOST_NOT_FOUND / UNKNOWN) is clean and the email_logs persistence pattern (kind/status/error_class/meta) is the right shape for the upcoming Phase 7B Email Center.
